request.description:
Escrow stack requires you to include a timestamp to the payload, sign the payload and attach the signature to the payload.

📘 NOTE: The "RUN ONCE" API should be executed first to import the necessary libraries for signature generation.

The actual timestamp & signature generation is done in the collection's pre-run script.

When you invoke a api in this postman collection, the pre-run script generates a timestamp and signature and populates the collection variables with the values.

The timestamp and signature is attached to the payload via collection variables {{timestamp}} and {{signature}}

Load the postman-util-lib from github.io and load into postman global variable.

## Headers:

apikey: A signed JWT provided to you by VouchPay

## Request Body:

payouts\[\*\].**payout_ref**:\[required\]\[String\]: A unique reference to this payout request.

payouts\[\*\].**amount**:\[required\]\[Amount\]: The amount to payout.

payouts\[\*\].**mode**: \[required\]\[String\]\[Valid Values: UPI|IMPS|NEFT|RTGS\] : The mode used for the payout. You can do the UPI and IMPS are Instant Payout Modes, NEFT is hourly and had holidays. RTGS has a minimum amount of 2 lakhs.

**transaction_note**:\[optional\]\[String\]: used to send a recon info to the receiver. Be advised some banks will not show this in their account statement.

payouts\[\*\].**payee**: A JSON object that references the user to whom you want the payout to be done.

payouts\[\*\].payee**.user_ref**: A unique reference to the user in your platform that is the recepient of the funds.

payouts\[\*\].payee.**user_name**:\[required\]\[String\]

payouts\[\*\].**beneficiary**: A JSON object with the relevant recipient's UPI id or bank account details

payouts\[\*\].beneficiary.**account_name**:\[required\]\[string\] Name associated with the bank account of the payee or receiver of funds.

payouts\[\*\].beneficiary.**account_no**:\[required for IMPS|NEFT|RTGS payouts\]: the account no of the payee or recipient of the funds.

payouts\[\*\].beneficiary.**ifsc**:\[required for IMPS|NEFT|RTGS payouts\]: the ifsc of the payee's Bank.

**LIFECYCLE of a Payout**

Upon Initiation, you will get the below response

``` json
{
    "code": "EL_PS",
    "message": "payout submitted to Bank, will update transaction status via webhooks"
}

 ```

When a debit for the Payout is detected. You will receive a processed webhook.

_**Processed Webhook**_

``` json
{
  code: 'PO_BP_DCP',
  status: 'processed',
  message: 'Your Payouts has been Processed',
  payout_ref: 'test-01-imps-01',
  bankref: '126131921426',
  signature: ''
}

 ```

If the Debit is Reversed due to a Failure such as invalid vpa or credit refused by receiving bank.

You will receivie a failed webhook.

_**failed webhook**_

``` json
{
  code: 'ERR_BP_IPR',
  status: 'failed',
  message: 'Your Payout failed, try again',
  payout_ref: 'test-01-fa-01',
  bankref: '126131921427',
  cause: 'Incorrect Benefeciary Details,check the account number and ifsc code',
  signature: ''
}

 ```
